emotional_tone: Futuristic, commanded, slightly mysterious, and elite. Merging high-end audio hardware interfaces with cyberpunk AI orchestration.

scale_and_rules.specific_instructions: Never center headings by default. Use 'Unbounded' for all public-facing and dashboard primary headings. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for timecodes, AI models (GPT-4/Claude), and live data feeds.

rules.contrast_requirement: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for all body text. Use background-color shifts instead of shadows for dark mode card separation.
rules.hover_states: Hover must shift to a lighter background (e.g., bg-zinc-800 to bg-zinc-700) and explicitly set text color.

glassmorphism.usage: Public live player and sticky headers.

neumorphism_tactile.usage: Avoid. Use Flat Solid surfaces or Glassmorphism instead.

retro_terminal.usage: LLM Orchestration View and System Logs.

borders_and_glows.active_elements: Use 1px solid borders with subtle inner glows. Example: shadow-[inset_0_0_12px_rgba(255,20,147,0.2)] for active live streams.

admin_dashboard.strategy: High Density Grid (Bento Protocol Mode B)
admin_dashboard.spacing_scale: Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. Tight margins between structural elements.

components.sidebar: Fixed, dense, text-sm links, prominent 'LIVE' indicator badge.
components.header: Solid dark background with hard bottom border. Do not use transparent headers.

public_player.alignment: Optical alignment, heavily relying on large visual cover art and abstract waveforms.
public_player.spacing: Massive breathing room. p-12 to p-24.

components.now_playing_widget: Glassmorphism card overlapping the hero background. Must include high-contrast typography and a pulsing 'LIVE' badge.
components.ai_dj_roster: Flat rectangular cards. Hover effects should introduce a subtle border color shift (e.g., border-purple-500/50) and a slight -translate-y-1.
components.audio_waveform: Implement using Recharts (bar chart simulating frequencies) or Framer Motion sequenced divs. It must feel kinetic.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular (no in-between). Primary buttons use bg-pink-600 hover:bg-pink-500 text-white. Secondary buttons use transparent backgrounds with border-white/20.
components.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized to be flat, dark-themed (bg-[#0F0F14]), with 1px border. No native HTML inputs.

motion.transitions: Specific properties only. Example: transition-transform duration-300 ease-out, opacity duration-200. NEVER use 'transition-all'.
motion.micro_interactions: Play/Pause buttons need scale-down on active (active:scale-95).
motion.animations: Subtle pulsing opacity (animate-pulse) on the 'LIVE' indicator. Marquee text for long track names.

accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the audio waveforms.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='play-pause-button', data-testid='dj-selector').

media.icons: lucide-react (installed). Use sharp, consistent sizing (e.g., w-5 h-5).

image_urls.description: Colorful abstract sound wave on black background, used as the main visual for the live web radio.
Glowing digital face for the primary AI DJ persona.
Glass sculpture head for a sophisticated, intellectual AI DJ.
Modern recording studio with neon lighting to set the station management mood.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a hybrid application. The public-facing radio player should be a massive, immersive experience with the 'abstract sound wave' image as a dark background, heavily utilizing glassmorphism for the player controls. The admin area (accessible via a clear 'Manage Station' or similar link) must switch to a dense, tactical 'Bento Grid' dashboard. Do not use generic Vercel/Stripe styles. Rely on pure HTML+Tailwind for layouts, and heavily customized Shadcn components for interactive logic. Never leave pure transparent backgrounds behind text. Every card in the dashboard should have a 1px border of white/10 to stand out against the deep app_bg.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: 1. IMPORTANT: Ensure all created frontend files are .js/.jsx (NOT .tsx). 2. NEVER apply 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions. 3. NEVER center-align text at the app root level. 4. NEVER use AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, etc.) as icons; strictly use lucide-react. 5. Prioritize existing Shadcn components but override their styles to match the 'Electric & Neon' dark theme (e.g., removing soft shadows, adding hard borders). 6. Incorporate 'data-testid' on all interactive elements. 7. Build the UI exclusively for Dark Mode first. 8. Do NOT use placeholder URLs for images; strictly use the provided media URLs.
